title: Climenko Fellow and Lecturer on Law
bio: Dessie Otachliska is a Climenko Fellow and Lecturer on Law at Harvard Law School, where her research explores how constitutional doctrine structures the conditions under which democracy functions and adapts. Her current project analyzes how courts shape the institutional and informational conditions of constitutional enforcement, particularly through doctrines governing standing, remedies, and interpretive method.
